wire.settings.hub_defaults.agents.help.note: Creation default for new agent and skill links, and a ceiling on existing ones: turning it off also pauses automatic updates for agent and skill links whose own subscribe is on, while an explicit per-link subscribe still governs when the switch is on. Hub-specific model override is deprecated, not editable. Placeholders retain their exact names; private visibility must remain explicit. Wrap explanatory copy rather than truncating it.
